metrics.dtn_port_modal_reference: top=physical_z_max; bottom=physical_z_min; bottom lossy power uses boundary-plane phase attenuation
metrics.dtn_port_modal_amplitude_convention: auxiliary unknown a_j is the total-field port projection. top outgoing amplitude = a_j - incident_projection_j; bottom outgoing amplitude = a_j. Power uses boundary-plane outgoing amplitude after applying boundary_phase. This run uses per-mode boundary-magnitude scaling; the actual q and boundary phase are recorded for the solver-to-boundary amplitude conversion.
metrics.dtn_port_power_metric_note: Stage-4 dtn_port R/T is computed directly from auxiliary outgoing modal amplitudes on the finite top and bottom port faces. Selected modes with positive outward real-Poynting flux contribute even when a below-critical lossy mode retains propagating=false; lossless evanescent modes carry zero modal power.
metrics.dtn_port_solver_basis_to_boundary_mappin: For each mode q=exp(Im(kz)*z_boundary); solver auxiliary and incident projections use the q-scaled basis, and the recorded boundary_phase applies q*exp(i*kz*z_boundary) before reporting outgoing_amplitude_at_boundary. Per-mode q and log(q) are included in the diffraction-order and auxiliary-amplitude rows.
